messages:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered PDR-8923 for service 'inference-api-prod' (error rate > 5% across region us-east-1) — https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDR-8923
incident-bot: auto-note: 3 pages sent (sms/phone) to schedule 'ai-platform' due to escalation policy 'prod-high-latency'
sam: acked. i'm looking. seeing spike in 504s from the edge LB, but PD shows 'inference-api-prod' — odd. :eyes:
jordan: wait — the requests hitting the edge are for /v1/stream on inference-edge cluster. PD routing says 'inference-api-prod' because schedule-id mapping was stale after last deploy. i think PD routed to the wrong on-call.
maya: checking oncall-scheduler logs now. last successful sync 1856004200, attempted sync at 1856007600 -> failed: 502 Bad Gateway from HR-SSO when fetching roster.
on-JSON block:
```
2026-03-14T02:46:40Z sync-job start
fetching schedules -> 502 from https://hr.example/api/oncall
error: upstream fetch failed
retry scheduled (backoff)
```
ops-oncall: if PD paged the wrong people we need to mute the misrouted incident and create a new one for inference-edge so the correct team gets full context. i'll mute PDR-8923 now.
ops-oncall: `pd incidents acknowledge PDR-8923 --user ops-oncall` -> acknowledged. muting notifications. :white_check_mark:
sam: i'll open a new incident for inference-edge and link the misrouted one. creating: PDR-8924 -> https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PDR-8924
jordan: mitigation in parallel: scaled inference-edge nodepool +2 GPUs and rolled traffic to warm model variant. traffic dropped 504s immediately for some users.
maya: schedule sync recovered at 1856007950 — sync job succeeded after retry when we re-ran the token refresh. detected mapping mismatch: schedule-id 0x7a12 was replaced by 0x8c33 in PD but our mapping table still pointed old id to 'ai-platform'.
jordan: root cause summary: schedule-sync job failed due to expired service account token -> mappings stale -> PD escalations sent to wrong schedule -> wrong responders paged.
ops-oncall: customer impact: transient increased 504s for ~12 minutes across < 0.5% of active sessions. no data loss, higher latency for some requests. sent update to SRE-alerts and support to prepare templated customer comms.
maya: immediate fix deployed: rotate service account token, add healthcheck + alert on sync failures, add 3 retries with jitter, and add quick verification step that mapping count matches PD API before allowing bridge close.
jordan: follow-ups: (1) postmortem + RCA (owner: jordan), (2) runbook update for schedule-sync and token rotation (owner: maya), (3) PD config audit to check orphaned mappings (owner: sam). created task tracker entries.
sam: thanks everyone. tagging for oncall handoff: @oncall-scheduler please ensure next rotation doesn't have gap. :thumbsup:
oncall-scheduler: noted — will add an hourly monitor for sync failures and a playbook step to escalate if no successful sync in 30m.
incident-bot: incident PDR-8924 created for inference-edge, PDR-8923 marked as routed-incorrectly and muted. incident status: PDR-8924 -> resolved at 1856007999.
ops-oncall: closing thread. we'll publish a short incident note after the RCA. :memo:
